temperature_note: temperature=0 is sent on every request, but OpenRouter's model list does not show temperature as a supported parameter for these models, so providers may ignore it.

prompt_format_instructions.number: give the answer as a single number (digits only, no units).
prompt_format_instructions.integer: give the answer as a single whole number (digits only, no units).
prompt_format_instructions.label: give the answer exactly as written on the map (just the name, nothing else).
prompt_format_instructions.multiple_choice: give the answer as the single letter of the correct option.
prompt_format_instructions.sequence: give the answer as a JSON list of names exactly as written on the map, in order, e.g. ["A", "7"].

prompt_note: The user message is [text prompt, image (PNG as base64 data URL)]. The exact prompt for each call is saved in raw/<model>/<task_id>.json under request.prompt.
answer_extraction: last 'FINAL ANSWER:' line of the reply (fallback: last line); see eval/extract.py
scoring: eval/score.py: numbers within the task's tolerance_rel/tolerance_abs, integers exact, labels case/dash/whitespace-insensitive, sequences element-wise, multiple_choice by letter
